name: power spectrum density
definition_zh: 描述信号或随机过程的功率或方差随频率分布的谱密度函数。
scope_note: 可用于轨道不平顺和脉动风等随机过程的统计表征；单边谱和互功率谱分别保留。
usage_overview: 用于描述不平顺、风速或动力响应在频率上的强度分布，主要服务于激励样本生成、线路谱拟合，以及响应主频、有效频带和模型差异的比较。轨道几何分析常使用空间频率，振动响应分析常使用时间频率，二者应结合运行条件区分。

complete_examples.text: In the present work, a large amount of measured track irregularities are concentrated as a group form of the track irregularity power spectrum density.

Generally, studies of the random irregularities of tracks used as excitations of the vehicle-track system are usually classified into two types: in the studies of the first type, the rail profile irregularities are obtained from the measurements performed by the track inspection car, whereas in the studies of the second type, the irregularities are obtained from the inversion of the statistical power spectrum density (PSD).
At last, the track irregularity time−frequency analyze method based on the PSD (Power spectrum Density)-HHT (Hilbert−Huang Transform) was proposed.
在物理上,WVD是信号能量化的时-频表示形式,而轨道不平顺功率谱密度PSD(Power Spectrum Density)实际上也是一种信号能量密度的表达形式。
